short_schinese: 率领梁山好汉，打八幕经典水浒战役。从野猪林营救、江州劫法场到三打祝家庄，指挥英雄与部队完成伏击、救援和攻坚。这款2D等距即时战略游戏还包含驻守战与单人人机1v1：采集金矿和木材，建设营寨、训练兵种、招募英雄并研究科技。利用战争迷雾、编队、巡逻和驻军安排攻守，让英雄技能与普通部队相互配合。八幕均可直接选玩，也能在竞技场试用英雄，或用内置关卡编辑器布置地形、单位、增援与胜负条件，保存后试玩自己的战场。
short_english: Lead the heroes of Water Margin through eight missions in this 2D isometric RTS. Rescue allies, build camps and command troops, then defend Liangshan or battle the AI in single-player skirmishes. Includes a level editor. Game interface: Simplified Chinese.
about_schinese:
[p]《水浒英雄传：八幕战役》是一款取材于《水浒传》的2D等距即时战略游戏。指挥宋江、林冲、鲁智深、武松等梁山好汉，在营救、破阵与攻城之间调兵遣将。[/p]
[h2]八幕战役，各有打法[/h2]
[p]大闹野猪林、智取生辰纲、醉打蒋门神、江州劫法场、三打祝家庄、大破连环马、智取大名府、三败高太尉——八幕均可直接选玩。[/p]
[p]从暗随救人、诱招反击，到扎营扩军、断援攻城与水陆协同，每关围绕不同目标展开。指挥英雄完成关键行动，也要安排部队、补给与撤离路线。[/p]
[h2]经营营寨，分兵攻守[/h2]
[p]派遣喽啰采集金矿与木材，修建兵营、箭楼等建筑，训练部队、招募英雄并研究科技。利用兵种配合、战争迷雾、编队、巡逻与驻军，在进攻和防守之间分配兵力。[/p]
[h2]驻守梁山，对抗电脑[/h2]
[p]驻守战提供20、30、60波预设，守住山寨，抵挡接连来袭的官军。单人人机1v1可选择AI难度与胜利条件，对抗会采集、建造、练兵和进攻的电脑对手。[/p]
[h2]试演英雄，亲手造关[/h2]
[p]在竞技场自由点将、试用技能，通过英雄图鉴了解梁山人物。内置场景编辑器可布置地形、单位、装饰、增援、波次与胜负条件，保存到本地后立即试玩；据守数值编辑器还可调整单位、技能与敌军波次。[/p]
about_english:
[p]Command the outlaws of Water Margin in a 2D isometric real-time strategy game. Lead Song Jiang, Lin Chong, Lu Zhishen and Wu Song through rescues, formation-breaking battles and assaults on fortified camps.[/p]
[h2]Eight missions, different objectives[/h2]
[p]Rescue Lin Chong in Wild Boar Forest, seize the birthday convoy, confront Jiang Menshen, raid the execution ground at Jiangzhou, assault Zhu Family Manor, break the chained cavalry, infiltrate Daming Prefecture and defeat Gao Qiu. All eight missions can be selected directly.[/p]
[p]Move between stealthy rescues, bait-and-counter duels, camp building, cutting off reinforcements and coordinated land-and-water operations. Use heroes for key actions while managing troops, supplies and escape routes.[/p]
[h2]Build your camp and command your army[/h2]
[p]Send workers to gather gold and wood. Build barracks and watchtowers, train troops, recruit heroes and research upgrades. Combine unit roles, hero abilities, fog of war, control groups, patrols and garrisons to divide your forces between attack and defense.[/p]
[h2]Defend Liangshan and face the AI[/h2]
[p]Defense mode offers 20-, 30- and 60-wave presets. Single-player 1v1 skirmishes let you choose AI difficulty and victory conditions against a computer opponent that gathers, builds, trains and attacks.[/p]
[h2]Try heroes and create your own battles[/h2]
[p]Experiment with heroes and abilities in the arena, or explore the hero compendium. The built-in scenario editor lets you place terrain, units, decorations, reinforcements, waves and victory conditions, save locally and play your creation. A separate defense configuration editor can adjust units, abilities and enemy waves.[/p]
[p]The game interface is currently available in Simplified Chinese.[/p]
